Who is Dr. Mina Dimitri at Dr. Fit Clinic?
Dr. Mina Dimitri is the veterinarian in charge of DR Vet Clinic, and oversees the provision of integrated services for pets, including diagnosis, treatment, and advanced care.

The clinic offers comprehensive services including digital X-ray, ultrasound, IDexx tests, a fully equipped operating room, all vaccinations and deworming and parasite medications, dental cleaning, and cat boarding.
